lena-janys--konstanz.name: Lena Janys
lena-janys--konstanz.title: Professor of Econometrics
lena-janys--konstanz.notes: Her homepage and IZA bio say Professor of Econometrics at University of Konstanz; the IZA page also lists 'Research Fellow'. The homepage does not list the AEJ paper, so the identity match comes from IZA. The Newcastle University profile (listed as Lecturer, found in search) is likely outdated and was not read (rate-limited). Homepage gives PhD University of Aarhus, no year.
